_comment: Merge this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-level, all projects) or a repo's .claude/settings.json. Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH with this repo's path. Every event points at the same script; it decides what to record from hook_event_name. Empty matcher = all occurrences (Stop and UserPromptSubmit do not support matchers; empty is correct for them). After editing settings.json, restart Claude Code sessions (or run /hooks) for it to take effect.
